topics.title: Vietnam Confessions & Garden Tools
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard recounts his experiences in Vietnam, including unsettling conversations about killing "gooks" and using military-style garden tools for potential violence. He describes bizarre stories like juggling enemy grandparents’ dismembered limbs and overhearing disturbing details regarding the OJ Simpson case.

topics.title: Dental Trauma and War Memories
topics.summary: During a radio show, the host recounts disturbing memories of Vietnam involving his wife’s dental injuries sustained during combat. He then discusses bizarre wartime experiences including throwing Vietnamese soldiers into helicopter blades after they refused to talk alongside recollections of opium use, revealing he punched her teeth out years prior.

topics.title: Stern Radio - OJ Simpson Investigation Updates
topics.summary: Howard Stern and his co-hosts discuss the ongoing investigation into Nicole Brown Simpson’s murder, including reports about a shovel found at OJs residence, changing alibis, speculation regarding motives, and Jackie Platinum's comedy show appearances with ticket sales. They also address rumors surrounding OJ’s behavior and reported evidence discovered during the case.

topics.title: O.J. Investigation Discussion
topics.summary: During a radio discussion, hosts discussed the ongoing investigation into Nicole Brown Simpson’s death, including evidence collected at her home and hotel room such as bloody towels and ski masks, witness reports of a vehicle resembling O.J.’s near the crime scene, and forensic analysis being conducted on DNA data.

topics.title: OJ Simpson Trial and Nicole Brown Simpson’s Appearance
topics.summary: The broadcast discusses allegations of domestic violence involving O.J. Simpson, referencing police calls at his home and reports of physical abuse against Nicole Brown Simpson. A significant portion focuses on speculation regarding Nicole’s breast development based on photographs from 1980, with the hosts examining her appearance in detail.”}p>”/div”/>

topics.title: Boy Drowns in Pennsylvania Water Park Waves
topics.summary: A young boy drowned while on a school trip to Dorney Park’s Wildwater Kingdom when he slipped under the ‘waves’ attraction and was not found for over an hour after the group had left. Lifeguards conducted a training session but failed to locate him before the students departed.
